name: Wakkanai (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Wakkanai city emblem in orange: an interlaced six-pointed star enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Wakkanai, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 April 1968; the emblem dates from 1 April 1949.

features.role: Wakkanai city emblem — an interlaced six-pointed star enclosing a stylised character
